verdict.rationale: Muse's own docs say that once a goal or task is set, it "continues to work on a schedule and in response to relevant events, taking the next step and following up" (muse-docs-20). It keeps working after the app is closed and sends notifications when something needs attention (muse-docs-26, muse-docs-35), and tasks are tracked in a Goals tab (muse-docs-5). However, the evidence describes agent-driven follow-up rather than a user-facing scheduler where you define a recurring cadence or a one-off run time and get a results report back. missing for 10: explicit user-defined recurring/cron-style scheduling, one-off scheduled-at-time tasks, documented result delivery for scheduled runs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
